source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Press load default,save and reboot.
3. Boot in BIOS,compare setting should matches SPEC.
4. Change BIOS all/random setting in this function,to non-default  setting.
5. Save and reboot.
6. Boot in BIOS and check your setting still exist.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. The default setting should matches SPEC."
2. No error log happen.
3. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
4. Check your set still exist.

original_test_intent: Verify AMD South Bridge chipset defaults and persistence of approved non-default controls without losing USB, SATA, network or low-speed controllers, altering required interrupt/power behavior, breaking boot/storage/console paths or stranding management.
original_method: Manually load defaults, compare named South Bridge fields with the exact board SPEC, change only a bounded controller-specific matrix, save and apply the documented reset, verify persistence and correlate each field with controller, device, resource and functional evidence.
manual_activity: An engineer must interpret, operate and visually accept South Bridge BIOS fields. Automated controller/device inventories only corroborate the manual firmware acceptance.
required_inputs: Named fields mapped to USB, SATA, NIC, LPC/eSPI/SPI, interrupt and power dependencies
SPEC defaults and approved non-default values
Persistent identities for boot storage, management NIC, console/input and other critical devices
Warm/cold reset requirement, stable power and independent recovery
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random or disable a required controller or port without exact field/device approval.
Protect boot storage, management NIC, keyboard/console, BMC host interface and recovery media paths.
Do not switch storage modes or write disk/RAID metadata as part of this case.
Capture persistent controller/device identity, resources and error baselines before changes.
Stop on critical-device loss, address/interrupt conflict, link/storage errors, boot failure or management loss.
Restore the approved final state; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only USB/SATA/NIC/low-speed controller and persistent device inventories, PCI/resource/interrupt state, storage/network health, kernel logs and BMC status.
Compare approved expected deltas for each operator-controlled field.
Do not drive BIOS, rebind drivers, change storage/network policy, write media or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve board-specific fields, dependencies, devices, values, reset and recovery.
Perform and capture default-first and bounded non-default firmware phases.
Interpret controller/device/boot evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects agent BIOS execution. No source command exists; OS driver, storage or network changes would test different layers.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the firmware method and add version-recorded, read-only controller/device/resource/storage/network evidence only.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The default-first lifecycle, null script and 5/10-minute fields are retained; all/random remains source text only.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a board-specific map from each South Bridge field to controllers, ports, persistent devices, resources, power state and critical functions; execute one bounded change at a time and diff only the expected consequences.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact AMD board/chipset, BIOS/AGESA and installed controller/device population.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/AGESA/BMC, OS/kernel, drivers, controller/device firmware and inventory-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform South Bridge field documentation and approved controller/device guidance.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces random page-wide changes with controller-specific causal checks and critical-path protection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; preserves defaults/persistence and adds device/resource/functional continuity coverage.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/controller/device map, values, reset, critical paths and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Modern AMD platforms may integrate traditional bridge functions differently; board documentation controls applicability.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve selected fields and populated controllers. Results must identify tested ports/devices and exclusions and cannot claim all South Bridge functions.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, field/controller/device/default matrix, approval and recovery
Baseline persistent devices, resources, storage/network/console and BMC health
Load Default captures plus SPEC and controller-state comparison
Per-field non-default captures, persistence and expected device/resource deltas
Approved final state, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The default-first and persistence lifecycle agrees with the criteria. Exact board fields and device dependencies are readiness inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The South Bridge configuration lifecycle is clear. Board-specific details must gate execution but do not permanently block the master case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual firmware operation and adds controller-specific critical-path safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its device/storage/network evidence while correcting classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates BIOS acceptance from supporting enumeration and rejects OS-layer substitutions.

review_improvement: Makes each bridge field traceable to exact controllers and critical devices so persistence cannot mask a missing storage, network, input or management path.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core operation is interactive firmware configuration and visual verification. Software can inspect consequences but cannot complete the BIOS acceptance, so MANUAL ONLY is required.
no_automatic_retry: Do not automatically repeat South Bridge changes, resets or recovery after controller, device, storage, network, boot or management anomalies; preserve first evidence and obtain engineer disposition.
